title: Played pawn sprint: keeps dash speed? new vs old dash setting (DPC 0.9.172-dev10)
intro: One controller (or keyboard). Open flat ground with room to run 15+ seconds in a line or wide circles, out of combat, the Arisen with full stamina, not possessing anyone, co-op off. About 1 minute. Press End (keyboard) when ready. Page Up reruns a test. End (keyboard) ends any step early.

probes.pspd: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local c = D and D.state.active and D.state.pawn_chara; return c and H.speed(c, 'pawn')
probes.aspd: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if D and D.state.active then return nil end; return H.speed()
probes.pdash: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local h = D and D.state.pawn_human; return h ~= nil and h:call('get_IsDash') == true
probes.adash: local a = H.arisen(); local h = a and a:call('get_Human'); return h ~= nil and h:call('get_IsDash') == true
probes.flag: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local h = D and D.state.pawn_human; local c = h and h:call('get_HumanCommonActionCtrl'); return c ~= nil and c:call('get_IsEnableDashToRequestedMoveSpeedOfNormalLocomotion') == true
probes.req: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local h = D and D.state.pawn_human; local c = h and h:call('get_HumanCommonActionCtrl'); return c and c:call('get_RequestedMoveSpeedOfNormalLocomotion')
probes.pstam: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local c = D and D.state.pawn_chara; local m = c and c:call('get_StaminaManager'); return m and m:call('get_RemainingAmount')
probes.pnode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and tostring(H.node(D.state.pawn_chara, 0)) or ''
probes.native: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.native.pip ~= nil
probes.on: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.preq: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local q = D and D.native.pip; return q ~= nil and q:get_field('RequestDash') == true
probes.pswitch: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local q = D and D.native.pip; return q ~= nil and q:get_field('DashSwitch') == true
probes.penable: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local q = D and D.native.param; return q ~= nil and q:call('get_IsEnableDashAction') == true

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
As the ARISEN: hold sprint and run in a straight line (or wide circles) the whole time. 10 seconds. (Baseline speed.)
Taking over your main pawn (new behaviour). Stand still. 5 seconds.

expect.label: dash-to-requested-speed as the game has it (false = was the cause)

steps.text: As the PAWN: hold sprint and run straight / wide circles the whole time. Does it keep sprinting? 12 seconds.

expect.label: pawn sprint speed (should match the Arisen's)

steps.text: Stop. Switching to the OLD behaviour for comparison (re-taking the pawn). Stand still. 6 seconds.
As the PAWN again: hold sprint, same path. Does it drop back to run speed like before? 12 seconds.
Back to the new behaviour, and back to the Arisen. 6 seconds.
Done. Tell Claude: did the pawn keep sprinting in the first run and drop off in the second?
